case_title: MERCURY INSURANCE COMPANY VS. CALIFORNIA STATE AUTOMOBILE ASSOCIATION

docket_entries.description: DECLARATORY RELIEF, COMPLAINT FILED BY PLAINTIFF MERCURY INSURANCE COMPANY AS TO DEFENDANT CALIFORNIA STATE AUTOMOBILE ASSOCIATION SUMMONS ISSUED, JUDICIAL COUNCIL CIVIL CASE COVER SHEET FILED CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE SCHEDULED FOR JUN-27-2008 PROOF OF SERVICE DUE ON                  MAR-25-2008 CASE MANAGEMENT STATEMENT DUE ON         JUN-12-2008

SUMMONS ON COMPLAINT, PROOF OF SERVICE ONLY, FILED BY PLAINTIFF MERCURY INSURANCE COMPANY SERVED FEB-05-2008, SUBSTITUTE SERVICE ON NATURAL PERSON AS TO DEFENDANT CALIFORNIA STATE AUTOMOBILE ASSOCIATION
DISMISSAL WITH PREJUDICE OF COMPLAINT AND AS TO ENTIRE ACTION--EACH PART TO BEAR ITS OWN ATTORNEYS' FEES AND COSTS.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE SET FOR AUG-11-2008 IN DEPARTMENT 212 AT 1:30 PM FOR FAILURE TO OBTAIN AN ANSWER(S) FROM, OR ENTER DEFAULT(S) AGAINST, DEFENDANT(S). THE JUN-27-2008 CASE MANAGEMENT CONFERENCE IS OFF CALENDAR. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE OF AUG-11-2008 IS OFF CALENDAR. DISMISSAL ON FILE. NOTICE SENT BY COURT.
